title: Latency Dissector: route+model SLI comparator (streaming vs non-streaming)
creator: Jared Patel
description: Build a new observability surface — the Latency Dissector — that compares p50/p95/p99 SLIs for model+route combinations with an explicit split for streaming vs non-streaming IO modes. This ticket covers the telemetry plumbing (tracing hooks + metrics/log pipelines), aggregation logic, and the dashboard UI + alerting triggers required for on-call diagnostics and capacity planning. The goal is a single-pane comparator that makes it easy to detect divergences between streaming and blocking paths for any model or route and link directly to trace spans and recent error logs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for any selected model+route with streaming vs non-streaming columns; 2) Each cell links to a filtered trace view and recent error logs for the period; 3) Aggregation jobs run <=1m freshness for p50 and <=5m for p95/p99; 4) Alert rules available for divergence >30% on p95 between streaming and non-streaming for production routes; 5) Backfill completed for last 30 days for top 50 routes.
implementation_notes: Telemetry: add a lightweight tracing hook at serve-path entry to tag 'io.mode' (streaming|blocking) and 'route' + 'model_family'. Metrics: histogram buckets emitted for latency per-token and end-to-end; export via OTLP to central pipeline with a dedicated 'latency-dissector' aggregation job. Logs: enrich error logs with request_id and io.mode for linking. Dashboard: build a matrix view with rows=routes, cols=models, cells show p50/p95/p99 sparkbars and a compact percent-delta between io modes. Provide toggles to scope to environment (prod/staging) and timeframe.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: high cardinality from route+model+io.mode leading to storage blowup. Mitigation: only materialize top K routes (by qps) and provide rollup grouping for the rest. Risk: trace sampling could miss tail events. Mitigation: apply adaptive sampling for routes with elevated p95/p99 and enable short-term 100% tracing when divergence alert fires.
qa_plan: 1) Unit tests for aggregation job correctness using synthetic latencies. 2) Integration tests that simulate mixed streaming/blocking requests and assert SLI values. 3) Manual verification on staging: compare dashboard numbers against raw histogram query and traces for five sample routes. 4) Run backfill verification job comparing old vs new aggregation for top 10 routes.
